detailText: 01Build your confidenceAI Getting StartedLearn the basics of AI through practical examples and a personalized, hands-on session.Ask about this service A practical introduction shaped around what you want to learn. Explore where AI can be useful, where it falls short, and how to approach it thoughtfully.What's includedPersonalized educationPractical examples relevant to your workA one-page guideWhere the scope stopsDoes not include custom implementation or access to your production systems.

02Work through a challengeAI Problem-SolvingBring a specific challenge and work through possible tools, approaches, and next steps.Ask about this service Start with the problem rather than a particular tool. Explore possible approaches together, including options that do not need AI.What's includedA focused advisory conversationPossible tools and approachesA brief recapWhere the scope stopsDoes not include building a solution, guaranteed outcomes, or ongoing support.

03See the bigger pictureAI Workflow AuditTake a closer look at one business process to identify opportunities for improvement.Ask about this service Look at one defined workflow, where effort goes, and where a change might help. Consider a better process before adding more tools.What's includedOne defined workflowLimited discoveryConcise written findingsWhere the scope stopsDoes not include compliance audits, production access, or implementation.

04Put a good idea to workCustom AutomationGet help implementing a solution when the right next step involves connecting tools or automating tasks.Ask about this service When implementation is the right next step, define a separate scope around the actual problem and the systems involved.What's includedA separately defined implementation scopeTools chosen for the actual needAgreed deliverables before work beginsWhere the scope stopsNo integrations, timelines, or project outcomes are promised before scoping.
